purpose: Run any multi-step job: main session orchestrates, helpers spec, build, review in parallel (2 fix rounds max), approver finishes or escalates to the owner.

model.notes: suggestion, not a rule: spec writer and approver on the larger model, builder and reviewers on the mid-size or small model (set in the agent files)

subagents.use: factory-spec, factory-builder (or the seat's agent), up to 3 parallel factory-reviewer, factory-approver

cost_flags: helper loops use more tokens than one session
owner_approval: anything outward-facing (sending, publishing, spending, admin installs, sign-ins, servers, scheduled tasks, GPUs) always escalates to the owner
only the owner closes an escalated job
evaluation: Each job is a board item that moves spec -> build -> review -> approved or escalated; reviews are PASS/FAIL with fixes; the board refuses a third fix round.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Plain markdown agents and the board CLI; on the box any local model can fill each role.
